Name: Aesthetically Pleasing Hill-Top Farm
Author: RyukanoHi
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (as it should). So if you don't already have it, go over there and follow the install instructions for that first.

Then, once you have Content Patcher properly installed, just drop this into the Mods folder.




This mod was made using the 1.3 beta, so I'm not entirely sure if it's backwards compatible, if someone tests it with 1.2, let me know. I could make an .xnb version, but seriously, switch to Content Patcher, it's a much better alternative, and much easier.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]PathosChild[/url]﻿ for his general awesomeness regarding putting together SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Downloads.Description: Vanilla Hill-Top Farm with stone bridges and no stupid greenhouse rock. (Now with Update Keys)
